problem: reserve() is not awaited, so the out-of-stock check sees a promise and two orders can both be charged for the last item.
The check uses > where >= is meant, so the last units in stock can never be taken.
The shared default options object is changed on every call, so its watchers grow from order to order.
When the payment fails the reservation is not released, so the stock stays held for an order that will not be paid.
shippingCents expects kilograms but is given the weight in grams.
